name: anyone-can-code-cli
description: Anyone Can Code for Codex CLI: plain-English plan, build, verify. Same product family as Desktop; CLI-tuned hooks and install path. Built from Codex official docs.

interface.shortDescription: ACC for Codex CLI: plain-English plan → build → verify. Trust hooks with /hooks.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code CLI is the Codex CLI package of Anyone Can Code. Install from /plugins, trust hooks with /hooks, run $setup. Desktop users should install Anyone Can Code (Desktop) from the same marketplace. Open beta; still improving.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.

Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
